hooks.command: if command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec node "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/tools/site-text-guard.mjs"; elif grep -q 'apps/site/src/content'; then echo "The site's text is the operator's, and no agent writes it; with no node to read the call, the guard refuses any call naming apps/site/src/content (AGENTS.md; apps/site/index.md, whose words)." >&2; exit 2; fi
